logs/l14-percent-in-listing|log:2|runlog.summary: Accepted difference. The original uses each listing row as a printf format string in the execution log (sim-ui 19 Q23): '100% sure: %d %x %%' came out as '100\xc8\x9bRure: 4730280 10 %' (stack contents). The port writes the row literally (engine/sim/PATCHES.md 11.7).

trap15-a/a55-task0-negative-count-first|.summary: T4's defect report D1. Task 0 with D1.W = -1 on a 300-byte string as the first TRAP #15 of the program: the official program printed 255 'A' and then one byte $C0 after NOP and after MULU, and exactly 255 'A' after MOVE.L (SP)+ and after RTS (golden lines 3-6; the bytes after the 255th are residue of the host stack: undefined behaviour of strncpy without a NUL); the port prints exactly 255 every time (the engine's P24 ends the string at character 255 explicitly since gate I2). With other host calls before it (trap15-a/a05) the original printed exactly 255 in every case, like the port. Accepted: nothing a program can rely on (docs/porting/errata/T4.md D1, T3.md F1).
trap15-a/a55-task0-negative-count-first|.evidence: golden/trap15-a/a55-task0-negative-count-first.OutLog.txt lines 3-4 (255 A + $C0), 5-6 (255 A); T4's probe d1probe4; docs/porting/errata/T3.md F1
trap15-a/a55-task0-negative-count-first|.unconfirmed: the residue byte depends on the Borland code that ran before the TRAP, so Windows may print another byte or none; nothing to imitate either way.

trap15-a/a58-files-devices|report|result.summary: The Windows device name NUL (trap15-a 13 Files, SH6 errata entry 8, item 8): in the official program task 52 on NUL, a write of 3 bytes, the close, task 59 and task 51 all give D0.W = 0 as in the port, but the read of 3 bytes after task 51 gives D0.W = 1 (end of file: NUL is a device that swallows what is written); the port creates an ordinary file NUL and reads back the 3 bytes (D0.W = 0).
trap15-a/a58-files-devices|report|result.unconfirmed: Wine maps NUL to its null device as Windows does; run a58 on Windows (6.8) to confirm. If Windows agrees, SH6 treats NUL as an empty sink (the other device names, CON, PRN, AUX, COM1-9, LPT1-9, were not measured).

trap15-b/b06-modes-above-15|report|resul.summary: Drawing modes 18-23 (trap15-b 15 V8): under Wine the official program draws the red pixel unchanged for every one of them (Wine's SetROP2 refuses the values the table yields and keeps the copy mode); the port follows trap15-b 5.4 (mode 20 gives white, mode 22 the inverse of the pen, ...).
trap15-b/b06-modes-above-15|report|resul.unconfirmed: run b06 on Windows (tests/conformance/windows-confirm/README.md). If Windows draws the pen unchanged as Wine does, SH1 (surface, the ROP2 table of trap15-b 5.4) changes modes 18-23 to keep the copy mode; if Windows follows trap15-b's table, this entry is a property of Wine and is removed by regenerating the golden on Windows.
